name: sistema-gerenciador-de-mesas
description: Sistema Gerenciador de Mesas (SGM v7.0) - Virtual Tabletop (VTT) e Ferramenta do Mestre para RPG

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @sgm/client" "npm run dev -w @sgm/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sgm/shared && npm run build -w @sgm/server && npm run build -w @sgm/client
